item.title: Sisterly Love Collective celebrates 5th anniversary with Sunday Supper
item.description: It's been five years since the Sisterly Love Collective brought together women in our city's food, beverage, and hospitality industries.

item.title: Sixers and Flyers tap Levy over Aramark for new arena food provider
item.description: In a notable shift announced Friday, the Sixers and Flyers have selected Levy Restaurants - not Philadelphia‑based Aramark - as their hospitality partner.

item.title: Disaster as fencing wire gets tangled in spinning car wash in North Carolina
item.description: The first rule of going to the car wash with your truck is make sure there's nothing in the bed. A North Carolina man found that out the hard way.

item.title: Black History Month: Celebrating legacy of renowned Temple professor Molefi Asante
item.description: The 83‑year‑old author of more than 100 books is widely recognized for his pioneering work in African studies and his commitment to examining race, power and identity in the world.

item.title: Quakertown police chief on leave amid protest investigation
item.description: The borough solicitor confirms that Quakertown Police Chief Scott McElree - who also serves as the borough's city manager - is currently on workers' compensation leave.

item.title: AccuWeather: Sunny and mild start to the weekend for the Philadelphia region
item.description: The weekend starts off feeling like spring with highs in the 50s ahead of an arctic front on Sunday that will bring colder air in for the start of March.

item.title: SEPTA installs full‑height gates at Cecil B. Moore station to deter fare evasion
item.description: SEPTA officials say they are on track to install more than 200 full‑height gates at 14 stations by June.

item.title: Roommate arrested after woman found dead in South Philly: Police
item.description: A 30-year-old woman is in custody as police investigate a shooting and stabbing that killed another woman inside a South Philadelphia apartment on Friday night.

item.title: Video captures Wendy's drive-thru mayhem in Ewing Twp.; 3 facing charges
item.description: According to investigators, the trio damaged property inside the restaurant and attempted to assault employees with various items.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack Saturday on Iran's capital, with a cloud of smoke rising from the city's downtown.
